Maybe I’m just old, but I like doing phone stuff on my phone, computer stuff on my laptop & tv stuff on my tv.

I appreciate being able to do phone stuff on my laptop and laptop stuff on my phone when necessary, but never found much use for tablets.

This is my commentary on the new foldable iPhone.

record.text:
Apple have announced the foldable iPhone, the duo. There’s three reasons why I won’t be getting one:

1. It costs at least £2k.
2. Always skip the first version of a new Apple product as the next versions will fix the flaws on the first version.
3. Did I mention it costs at least 2k?
I've wanted a foldable iPhone since before foldable phones were a thing. I think I came up with the want in like 2014. Excited that it's out but curious about the crease. We'll see.
The foldable iPhone Duo will cost that much. An iPhone 17 *only* costs $1,129.
